DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 69 s. 2022 JUL 29 2022 Hon. RAFFY A. ANDAYA Municipal Mayor Municipality of Manjuyod Province of Negros Oriental Dear Mayor Andaya: This has reference to the letter of former Mayor Felix A. Sy dated 11 February 2022 seeking legal opinion from this Department on whether or not the Sanggunian Bayan, the Barangay representatives, and Local Finance Committee can correct/amend a Manjuyod [Local] Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (MDRRMC) Resolution. Per his representation, the Municipality of Manjuyod has accumulated unexpended Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Funds (DRRMF) for the past years. MDRRMC passed a resolution on 18 December 2021 , MDRRMC Resolution No. 2021- 06, to Revert the Special Trust Fund 2016-2020 and MDRRM Fund Capital Outlay for the Year 2011 up to Year 2020 for Food Packs & Relief Operations, Medical Supplies & Equipment, Assistance Relative to Typhoon Odette. Upon endorsement of the MDRRMC Resolution No. 2021-06 on 20 December 2021, the Sangguniang Bayan and the Punong Barangays together with the Local Finance Committee conducted a joint session/meeting. During the said meeting, they agreed and approved to correct the submitted MDRRMC Resolution from "Assistance Relative to Typhoon Odette" to "Cash/FinanciaI Assistance Relative to Typhoon Odette". It is the Legislative Body, the Local Finance Committee and the Barangay Representatives who approved the correction, not the MDRRMC considering that it is a MDRRMF. Hence, the instant query. Foremost, we find it imperative to know the powers and functions of the Local Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (LDRRMO) and LDRRMC. The LDRRMO prepares and submits to the local sanggunian through the LDRRMC and the LDC the annual LDRRMO Plan and budget (LDRRMP), the proposed programing of the LDRRMF, other dedicated disaster risk reduction and management resources, and other regular funding source/s and budgetary support of the LDRRMOI. The LDRRMC on the other hand, approves, monitors and evaluates the I Section RA No. 10121 "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

implementation of the LDRRMPs and regularly reviews and tests the plan consistent with other national and local planning programs2. In addition, thereto, the LDRRMC shall decide on the use of the unexpended balance of the LDRRMF which shall be incorporated in the Local Disaster Risk Reduction Management Fund Investment Plan (LDRRMFIP)/LDRRMP.3 On the use of the unexpended balance, last paragraph of Section 21, R.A. No. 10121, otherwise known as the "Philippine Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Act of 2010", provides: "Unexpended LDRRMF shall accrue to a special trust fund solely for the purpose of supporting disaster risk reduction and management activities of the LDRRMCs within the next five (5) years. Any such amount still not fully utilized after five (5) years shall revert back to the general fund and will be available for other social services to be identified by the local sanggunian." Further, pursuant to Items 6.4 and 6.5 of the NDRRMC-DBM-DILG JMC No. 2013-1, dated 25 March 2013, entitled "ALLOCATION AND UTILIZATION OF THE LOCAL DISASTER RISK REDUCTION AND MANAGEMENT FUND, the accumulated unexpended LDRRMF shall be used solely for the purpose of supporting disaster risk reduction and management activities of the LDRRMC within the next five years. Provided, however, that it may still be utilized for new expenditure items on the following conditions: I. Upon submission of a revised Annual Investment Program (AIP) as approved by the local sanggunian and Local Chief Executive (LCE); and 2. Upon recommendation of the LDRRMC in accordance with the approved Local Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Plan (LDRRMP)/LDRRMFlP.4 From the foregoing, it is submitted that the unexpended balances of the LDRRMF may be released and utilized for authorized new expenditure items upon submission of the revised AIP of the current year considering that the basis for the preparation of the LGU's annual and supplemental budget is the current year's Annual Investment Program.5 To summarize the procedure, the LDRRMFIP/LDRRMP is prepared and submitted by the LDRRMO to the LDRRMC for approval, which is in turn submitted by the latter to the Local Development Council (LDC) for deliberation and inclusion in the AIP, subject to LCE and local sanggunian approval.6 Applying the foregoing in the matter at hand, since the unexpended LDRRMF of the MDRRMC for the years 2011 to 2015 were still unutilized in the years 2016 to 2020, the said unexpended LDRRMF should be reverted back to the general fund by operation of 2 section RA No. 10121 3 Paragraph 4.4 COA Circular No. 2012-002, dated 12 September 2012 4 DILG Legal Opinion No. 38, S. 2019, 31 July 2019 5 DILG Legal Opinion No. 42, S. 2015, 06 November 2015 6 Supra at 5. Page 2 of 3

law and is now available for other social services to be identified by the local sanggunian. Whereas, in the unexpended LDRRMF of the MDRRMC for the years 2016 to 2020, such unexpended LDRRMF shall accrue to a special trust fund solely for the purpose of supporting disaster risk reduction and management activities of the LDRRMCs within the next five (5) years, in which only the LDRRMC has the power to correct/amend. Consequently, this Department is of the view that the AIP, not the LDRRMFIP/LDRRMP is subject to the approval of the LCE and local sanggunian. Hence, we submit that MDRRMC Resolution No. 2021-06 cannot be corrected by the Sanggunian Bayan, the Barangay representatives, and Local Finance Committee. Such power is lodged with the LDRRMC. The opinion of this Department is based solely on the facts and representations you have narrated in his letter and our appreciation of the same. We hope to have addressed his concern accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: NGAN MARLO Undersecretary for Local Government OUSLG/MLULLLS-LRALLD/lasm/rrao/clp copy furnished: DIR. LEOCADIO T.
